scripts.prepare:android: npm run clean:android && npm run build:web && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android && node scripts/configure-android.mjs
scripts.prepare:ios: npm run clean:ios && npm run build:web && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/configure-ios.mjs
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run prepare:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: npm run prepare:android && node scripts/configure-android-version.mjs && node scripts/configure-android-release.mjs && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
scripts.build:ios:simulator: npm run prepare:ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath ios/build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
